notes.title: Syncanite Foundation Board Game Kickstarter
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490686/172a06229875e62959656d333520c7e6adda3763.jpg

Dear all, 
Our Kickstarter for the board game was a huge success! More than 700 backers funded the project 10x the amount we needed and thus enable us to plan the next steps! As all of you already read on our Kickstarter page, a video game adaption of SYNCANITE FOUNDATION is planned. 

With this Steam page, we want to give you the opportunity to follow these developments from day 1! 
So: Welcome in the community! :D By the way: The Kickstarter campaign ends on the 21st of February at 1 pm CET, meaning you still have the chance to grab your copy if the board game at the best price! 

 Why Back Now? 
Backers will get SYNCANITE FOUNDATION – The Board game at the best price possible. Also, you help us to better estimate the size of the 1st edition, what helps us tremendously! 
Lastly: You support a small indie Team from Dortmund that can attract potential partners even better, the higher this number gets. So if you want the video game to happen you can help by pledging now! 

Back the Kickstarter Here 

Thank you for your support, and see you on the board! 
The Syncanite Games Team
